subject: gk
question: Which of the following schemes / programmes is NOT related to microfinance type of initiatives?
solution:
The correct solution is __**Ujjawala Scheme**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Ujjawala Scheme is** not** related to microfinance type of initiatives.
 
• The Ujjawala Scheme is a scheme launched by the Indian government to provide** free LPG** connections to women from poor households.
 
• Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi announced the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana on **May 1, 2016**.
